_comment: Emulator-only auth fixtures. These uids are fake, the passwords are fake,
and none of it touches a real project: the emulator accepts any project ID
beginning with 'demo-' without a GCP account existing. See ADR-0010.
The three users exist to cover the states ADR-0009 says the app must handle:
an anonymous user who has never signed up, an anonymous user who has
upgraded in place to email-link, and a returning account.
